critical_code_review_comments: Console hydration warning observed in preview: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' on /search. Inspection shows the offending span is injected by Emergent's preview-time dev tooling (data-ve-dynamic='true', x-excluded='true') — NOT shipped in production. No code change required.

Sidebar group labels (Dashboard/Negocio/Crecer/Admin) and home labels are translated to English when locale=EN. The test asserts the Spanish source strings exist (passing); UX in EN reads natural ('Business/Grow/Admin'). No action needed.

PhysicalCardsPanel order form correctly enforces pack-tier pricing client-side ($29 × packs) and the backend validates server-side (test_physical_cards_provider_order_and_listing). Push notification to admins on creation + to provider on status changes is wired through /api/admin/physical-cards PATCH (test_physical_cards_admin_listing_and_status passing).

Admin overview KPIs computed live from collections (74 users / 12 providers / 9 approved / 1 pending / 8 reviews / 52 clients / $0 revenue Q3 launch) — matches the test_admin_overview_endpoint schema (kpis + founders.slots_total + recent_signups all present).

/api/geo/reverse correctly normalizes Chicago coords (41.8781,-87.6298) → {city:'Chicago', state:'IL'} via Nominatim with User-Agent 'getamano/1.0', and tolerates None on rate-limit (asserted in test_geo_reverse_returns_city_state). Hardcoded US state-name → 2-letter map covers all 50 states + DC.

LocationPrompt 'Toda EE.UU.' / 'Search all of the US' skip link sets sessionStorage.skip_location_prompt so prompt does not reappear in the same session even with no city set — verified by reload after confirm (also skips when city is set).
